title: Independently verify PR3044 R2 native slice and residual wrappers
body:
PR3146's independent cold replay left the R2 native phase/residual-adapter slice dependent on the inherited native engine. This focused package answers that handoff for PR3044's exact archived base/extra providers.

The new checker binds the source word to the emitted tail/final events, identifies the changed W→E, E→FULL and W→FULL children, and verifies their exact 512-coordinate operators including global phase in both orientations. It also checks the four ordinary source endpoint adapters and all 54 used residual recipes per provider, with every pre/post wrapper bound to its owner, side and position after complete cleanup. The complete 204-gate scalar tail agrees with the reconstructed R1 control on all 632 arbitrary input columns in both orientations.

This reuses Sagar Thakrar's pinned independent Gaussian-integer kernel; the native producer/compiler and original R2 evaluator are not imported by the verifier. The new contribution is the R2 source/event binding and application of the independent kernel, not a new arithmetic implementation.

Validation:
- Both providers freshly regenerated with the original four native stages; all eight artifact hashes match PR3044's published receipt.
- The public regeneration entrypoint compares every proof-relevant payload with the authenticated retained artifacts.
- Registered Python 3.12 verification and isolated optimized execution pass, including 16 named semantic mutants per provider. Mutations are evaluated after artifact authentication and must fail the expected semantic predicate.
- Metadata/source pins, all 39 committed package/input byte comparisons and whitespace checks pass. Published head: `259043321323717b7e816d6be38ad5e1f0b69b4c`. Hosted CI is separate.

Scope is finite and partial: unchanged native operations still need to realize their declared frame maps. Other native children/warps, full cleanup semantics, physical execution/owners, precision/tape, all-size compilation and supplier/outer admission remain open. No new kappa, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem is claimed.

Scientific pins: PR3044 `1f922b25abff2d7fd87fa5b29619160862a06b59`, base `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`. Publication starts from refreshed canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`; priorities, selected result and live scientific inputs are unchanged. PR3146 was merged during the session. Task `independent-moment`, scope refined to its explicit native-slice handoff; scope key `5e0f415b25b13c102653`. The bounded overlap review is recorded in TASK.json; unpublished work and every historical diff are outside coverage.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19001329). Reproduce with:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr3044-r2-native-slice
```

Credit Nick Petalas (R2), Jeremy Kothe (R1), Marius-Paul Dumitrean (joint rank-7 words), Hiroki Kumazaki (PR3146/handoff), Sagar Thakrar (independent kernel), the earlier V45 binding audit and the retained native/geometry/owner authors. Full attribution, exact commands, limits and [concrete next questions](https://github.com/24kHandsome1201/integer-mult-bounds/blob/259043321323717b7e816d6be38ad5e1f0b69b4c/research/pr3044-r2-native-slice/README.md#open-next-questions) are in README: independently interpret the remaining cleanup dependency cone and bind the checked records to actual physical execution/owners. 24kHandsome1201 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human or proof-kernel review claimed. Apache-2.0.
